question_text: A 12-year-old boy presents to the emergency department with severe abdominal pain and nausea. He first began to have diffuse abdominal pain 15 hours prior to presentation. Since then, the pain has moved to the right lower quadrant. On physical exam he has tenderness to light palpation with rebound tenderness.
